types.name: QWED Live API Key v1 legacy

post_processing: v2: recompute CRC32 over the first 30 body characters and Base62-encode to width 6; accept only on exact match with the trailing 6. v1: enforce exact shape only (no checksum). Discard any qwed_test_ match.
delimiters: charset-complement lookarounds per type (see anchored_pattern); word boundaries are wrong here — a v1 body may end in hyphen, which no word boundary borders. On engines without lookaround support (e.g. RE2) use re2_pattern per type and treat re2_token_group (group 1) as the token: the whole match consumes surrounding delimiter characters, so submitting it breaks the v2 checksum and the revocation lookup, and a global scan must resume after group 1's end, not the whole match's.
